{{Quote|Last time I was here it was a fertile paradise. Now look at it&mdash;a desert.|[[Brenn Tantor]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Force Commander">''[[Star Wars: Force Commander]]''</ref>}}
'''Kalaan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Kalaan system/Legends|Kalaan system]] and home to a large [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base as of [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] launched an invasion of the planet. The [[Battle of Kalaan]] reduced [[Kalaan City]] to rubble and routed the Rebels.

The planet was occupied by the Empire and portions, if not all, of the planet were denuded of all flora. [[Kalaanite resistance|A resistance movement]] among the [[Kalaanite]] population continued fighting the Empire, but was unable to drive it off the planet.

[[Kalaan prison|An Imperial prison]] was also constructed. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the prison housed [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Brenn Tantor]]. Tantor, an Imperial [[General/Legends|general]] who was being court-martialed, [[Escape from Kalaan|escaped]] and defected to the Alliance with the [[Kalaan defectors|help]] of his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] squad, taking Skywalker with him.
